_comment: Editorial content for WAVESAPPR. This is a security line, not an operating business — it is the rights entitlement of Waves Home Appliances Limited. No image is attached.
description: Waves Home Appliances Limited (Right) is the entitlement line created by a rights issue of shares by Waves Home Appliances Limited, the PSX-listed appliance maker whose ordinary shares trade as WAVESAPP. It is a security line, not a separate operating company — it has no business, products or employees of its own — and it is shown as suspended on the Pakistan Stock Exchange's data portal.
sourceNote: PSX Data Portal security record for WAVESAPPR (name 'Waves Home Appliances Limited(Right)', status SUSPENDED), plus the company website waves.net.pk for the issuer's identity, read 2026-10-17.
